_readme: Idempotency contract — shared between DOS client (hooks/lib/dlq.ts, hooks/lib/streamEvent.ts) and Studio /api/v1 route handlers. Every POST declares the Idempotency-Key schema its clients must compute. {scope,schema} = iter-1 SessionEnd batch path. {scopeEvent,schemaEvent} = iter-2 streaming per-event path. syncModes lists which modes are supported. Placeholders resolve to values already present in the endpoint's Zod schema (see bindings). {digestOfBody} = lowercase hex sha256 of the canonical JSON of the body (@kit/database/idempotency-key → digestBody). Middleware withIdempotency validates that the client-sent Idempotency-Key header matches what keyFrom(body) produces; mismatch → 400. See Plans/Specs/studio-sync-resilience.md (Primitive #2) and Plans/Specs/studio-sync-streaming.md (Primitive #2).

scopes.session: Keyed by a single DOS session (one Claude Code run). Collisions across sessions are impossible.
scopes.work-session: Keyed by the work-session slug (MEMORY/WORK/{timestamp_slug}/). Spans multiple DOS sessions.
scopes.event: Keyed by an individual tool call or streaming event within a session. Used by iter-2 streaming path.
scopes.global: Keyed by an identity stable across all DOS installs and sessions (content digest, correction id, event id).
scopes.daily: Keyed by a YYYY-MM-DD date plus a secondary identifier. Safe for per-day aggregates.
scopes.hourly: Keyed by a YYYY-MM-DDTHH window or per-snapshot-time. Hourly cadence sync tools.
scopes.batch: Keyed by a digest of the payload batch. Content-addressable — same payload → same key.
scopes.vault: Keyed by a RESEARCH vault slug. Mid-vault partial syncs need distinct slugs.
scopes.plan: Keyed by a plan slug. Mirrors the vault pattern for Plans.

syncModeSet.batch: SessionEnd batch POST. One body can contain many rows. Used by iter-1 SessionEnd path.
syncModeSet.event: Per-event streaming POST mid-session. Single-row body. Used by iter-2 PostToolUse streaming path.

bindings._readme: Placeholder-to-field mapping. {source: 'payload'} fields must appear in the Zod schema for the corresponding endpoint. {source: 'computed'} fields are derived by the client before POSTing. {digestOfBody} = lowercase hex sha256 of canonical JSON of the entire body.

conflictSemantics._readme: Studio-side behavior when a POST arrives with an Idempotency-Key already seen. The contract test verifies each endpoint honors exactly one of these two patterns.
conflictSemantics.updateInPlace: Server stored the payload on first receipt; replay returns the cached response body with the original status and header X-Idempotent-Replay: true.
conflictSemantics.reject409: Server returns 409 Conflict with body { error: 'duplicate_idempotency_key', key: '<original>' }. Used when the resource is immutable once created.

header.name: Idempotency-Key
header.note: Keys must match the corresponding endpoint's {schema} or {schemaEvent} after placeholder substitution. Studio rejects malformed keys with 400 (invalid_idempotency_key) and mismatched keys with 400 (idempotency_key_mismatch).
